title: S1Cusp GATED:  cusp-aware above-G between-row bridge (plunge + V-flanks + row-face bridge,  full build 17450 green);  s30 locks far rows at 1e8G and 3e8G (verified boundary 1.5e18 -> 9e18),  1e9G+ rows OOM-killed in the dps-40 zeta channel;  fresh-process wall probe in flight
body: FORMAL (S1Cusp.lean,  549 lines,  5 theorems,  sorry-free,  pure real analysis,  full build 17450 jobs green).  S1Sample's  t-Lipschitz  sample-to-uniform  bridge  is  valid  in  the  finite  C^1  below-G  regime  only:  above  G  the  wp  face  keeps  the  ln  zero  cusps  of  log|zeta|  and  can  tend  to  -oo  at  super-G  zeros,  so  the  hLip  premise  fails  there.  S1Cusp  supplies  the  cusp-aware  sibling  for  faces  f  =  h  +  sum_j  c_j  .  log|t  -  g_j|  with  0  <=  c_j  <=  C:  (1)  cuspPlunge  -  a  single  positive  log  cusp  dominates  any  locally  bounded-ABOVE  smooth  part,  so  f  ->  -oo  at  the  cusp  for  every  M;  the  premise  is  BddAbove  of  h  on  Icc(g-1, g+1)  -  a  below-bound  does  NOT  control  the  face  from  above  (the  compiler  caught  this  in  the  draft:  h  =  1/|t-g|  is  bounded  below  yet  f  ->  +oo);  (2)  vFlankLeft/vFlankRight  -  on  the  two  flanks  of  width  c/(4L)  around  the  cusp  the  face  is  strictly  DECREASING  (left)  /  strictly  INCREASING  (right),  proven  from  a  SECANT  Lipschitz  condition  on  h  only  (no  differentiability  anywhere);  the  right  flank  is  a  mirror  reduction  of  the  left;  (3)  cuspUpperBridge  -  from  a  ROW  FACE  |f  u|  <=  B  at  sample  height  u,  with  |t  -  u|  <=  Dv  and  u  at  least  eps  from  every  cusp  and  0  <=  c_j  <=  C,  the  face  at  ANY  t  (cusp  points  included)  satisfies  f  t  <=  B  +  L|t  -  u|  +  C  .  n  .  log(1  +  Dv/eps)  -  the  bound  is  UNIFORM  in  the  plunge  because  the  face  truly  goes  to  -oo  at  the  cusps;  (4)  e1CuspWholeFromRows  glues  the  bridge  onto  E1C.Mres  on  (G_LAST,  T_MEAS]  from  the  row  face  +  the  cover  +  the  cusp-spacing  datum  (the  E1  threat  direction,  matching  S1Sample's  e1V3WholeFromSample  in  role).  GATES  (Float,  E1C-style)  record  the  VACUITY  at  the  measured  constants:  bridgeAdd  =  L2face .  Dv  +  C .  N .  ln(1  +  Dv/eps)  with  N  =  1.2544e14  (zeros  in  the  900G  cover  gap)  and  eps  =  0.013  (s23  worst  row)  gives  bridgeAdd  =  6.5570002736e15  =  9.367e11  x  B(7000)  --  the  bridge  is  FORMAL  but  vacuous  at  the  900G  cover,  exactly  as  the  t-metric  S1Sample  bridge  was;  the  DATA  cusp  amplitude  at  a  row  is  ln(1/d)  =  4.343  <<  B.  So  the  operative  between-row  control  remains  (a)  the  measured  cusp  face  robustness  and  (b)  the  P12  squeeze  leg;  S1Cusp  supplies  the  above-G  formal  counterpart  to  S1Sample  and  completes  the  pair  of  between-row  bridges  the  S1  uniform  statement  needs  (S1Sample  below  G,  S1Cusp  above  G).  Engineering  record  (pinned  mathlib  4.33.1,  this  toolchain):  section/variable  declarations  SILENTLY  DROP  OUT  of  the  context  of  later  theorems  in  this  tree  (the  gated  files  are  all  flat;  S1Cusp  is  now  flat  explicit  parameters  too);  calc  steps  with  a  multi-line  :=  by  block  need  the  tactics  indented  PAST  the  RHS  continuation  column  or  the  parser  re-synchronizes  and  corrupts  the  whole  file  downstream;  abs_add'  is  the  ANTI-triangle  form  |x|  <=  |y|  +  |x+y|  while  abs_add_le  a  b  is  the  plain  triangle  |a+b|  <=  |a|+|b|;  the  log  identity  is  Real.log_inv  (log  x^-1  =  -log  x),  not  neg_log;  mul_lt_mul_left  needs  a  typeclass  instance  that  resolves  only  via  the  explicit-positivity  form  mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left;  Finset.sum_const  gets  its  Fintype  metavariable  STUCK  during  rw  elaboration  unless  the  Finset  sort  is  pinned  in  the  goal  ((Finset.univ  :  Finset  (Fin  n)));  Finset.sum_sub_distrib  must  be  used  with  <--;  and  linarith  cannot  see  through  product  atoms  (L.(a-b)  +  c.(u-1)  terms  must  be  pre-composed  into  named  (a-b).(L  -  c/a)  forms). DATA  (s30  far-extreme  census,  tmp/s30_far_extreme.jsonl).  The  5-stream  la/re  pass  (L/A/B/C/D,  D  =  92577877714  zeros,  1994  s)  completed  and  2  of  the  5  target  rows  were  LOCKED  before  the  process  died:  r  =  1e8G  (t  =  3.0001046e18):  M  =  -648727552,  I_far  =  -2.356280581014696e18,  I_far  dps40  =  dps60  =  dps80,  f64  sum-match  TRUE;  r  =  3e8G  (t  =  9.0003138e18):  M  =  -1458497536,  I_far  =  -7.068834089235497e18,  I_far  dps40  =  dps60  =  dps80,  f64  sum-match  TRUE.  The  VERIFIED  EXTREME  BOUNDARY  moves  from  1.5e18  (5e7G)  to  9e18  (3e8G),  a  6x  extension.  M  is  again  integer-quantized  (exact  f64  on  both  rows  -  the  35th  and  36th  quantized  rows  to  date).  The  rows  at  1e9G/3e9G/1e10G  (t  =  3e19/9e19/3e20)  were  NOT  measured:  dmesg  confirms  the  s30  process  (PID  2957809)  was  OOM-KILLED  at  117  GB  RSS  (total-vm  124  GB)  -  the  kill  lands  on  the  t  =  3e19  row's  dps-40  rs-zeta  call  (the  I_far/la/re/lm  channels  are  cheap  there;  the  zeta  channel  is  the  sole  killer).  The  companion  s30v  verifier  is  a  RED  HERRING  at  this  stage:  its  HEIGHTS  =  (3e19,  9e19,  3e20)  are  t/G  RATIOS  feeding  t  =  G  *  r,  i.e.  heights  9e29..9e30  -  three  OOMs  with  no  information  (it  was  aimed  a  factor  G  =  3e10  too  high).  A  FRESH-PROCESS  WALL  PROBE  (tmp/zeta_fresh_wall.py,  PID  2986080)  is  in  flight  on  t  =  9e18/3e19/9e19/3e20  at  dps-40  (first  height  still  computing  at  ~60  GB  RSS  after  ~18  min)  to  separate  a  fundamental  mpmath  rs-zeta  wall  from  a  residency  artifact:  if  3e19  lands  fresh,  the  1e9G+  rows  are  resumable  (the  s30  script  is  resume-safe  by  t  VALUE)  and  the  engine  boundary  reaches  3e20  =  the  B7  leveraged  wall;  if  3e19  OOMs  fresh,  the  extreme  rows  need  a  zeta-CHANNEL  replacement  (C  rs-zeta  or  a  quadrature  zeta  channel),  since  every  other  channel  is  cheap  at  these  heights.  B7  STANDS  AT  ITS  LEVERAGED  WALL  until  then:  t  ~  g0  ~  3e20  is  ~33x  past  the  newly  verified  9e18.  No  RH  claim.
